outcome: Maternal morbidity following unscheduled peripartum hysterectomy
Postpartum complications (venous thrombosis, composite surgical morbidity)
cohort: 665 women who underwent unscheduled peripartum hysterectomy at Parkland Hospital between 1988 and 2012.
finding: Increasing BMI was associated with longer surgical times and more wound infections in women undergoing unscheduled peripartum hysterectomy.
